crossRefs.note: Out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer…
She said, “I will surely go with you. Nevertheless, the journey that you take won’t be for your honor; for Yahweh will…
Out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,
Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
